- [ASSISTANT_SAID] American Apparel's most common poly-cotton blend is 50% polyester and 50% combed cotton, referred to as "50/50" fabric.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] American Apparel offers other poly-cotton blends, such as 65% polyester and 35% cotton, depending on the specific product and style.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For specific product inquiries, it is recommended to check the product description or contact American Apparel's customer service.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Anvil calls their 50/50 fabric blend "Heather CVC", which stands for "Heather Colors with a Vintage Look and Feel".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] CVC is short for "Chief Value Cotton", describing a cotton/polyester blend that balances affordability and quality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Anvil's Heather CVC fabric blend consists of 60% combed ringspun cotton and 40% polyester, providing a soft, comfortable feel with good durability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Anvil 980 is a style of T-shirt made from 100% combed ringspun cotton, known for its comfort, durability, and affordability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Anvil 980 has a tubular construction, providing a more comfortable, seamless fit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Anvil 980 is preshrunk to reduce shrinkage during washing, ensuring a consistent fit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Anvil 980 is considered a classic fit, providing a comfortable, relaxed fit that is not too tight or too loose.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If a more fitted look is preferred, it is suggested to size down or consider a different style or brand.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The American Apparel BB401 is a unisex, short-sleeved T-shirt made from 100% fine jersey cotton.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The BB401 is known for its softness, durability, and versatility, with a slim fit designed to be form-fitting without being too tight.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The BB401 features a double-stitched neckline and sleeves for added durability and is available in various colors and sizes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The BB401 is popular for screen printing and customization, known for holding color well and resisting fading over time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, the American Apparel BB401 is a high-quality, comfortable T-shirt designed to provide a slim, form-fitting look.
